name: Digital breaker-command output boundary
summary: Shows the conversion from a received digital operating request to the assigned physical breaker output.
description: Shows the conversion from a received digital operating request to the assigned physical breaker output. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Accepted digital command” at the input and “Physical operating output” at the output. The output circuit still requires its normal supervision.
